visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and rectangular glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands centrally in a studio environment. Behind him is a large digital backdrop displaying the Taipei 101 skyscraper illuminated at night amidst a sprawling city skyline under a dark sky. He speaks directly to the camera, using open-palm hand gestures to emphasize his words. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a middle-aged male's midsection. He wears a tight blue polo shirt and a brown leather belt; his stomach protrudes significantly over the waistband. His right hand rests on his hip. The background is a flat, off-white wall. (3) The camera returns to the man in the black shirt. He continues his explanation, rotating his hands and pointing towards the camera. The studio lighting is bright and even, highlighting his facial expressions. (4) A small graphic overlay appears in the center, featuring a cartoon-style anime girl with pink pigtails, a white hat, and a pink outfit. She is depicted singing with her mouth open. (5) The shot changes to two black mice on a white surface. The mouse on the right is noticeably larger and more corpulent than the smaller mouse on the left. They are both stationary. (6) Back to the man in the black shirt. He continues gesturing dynamically with his hands, moving them in circular and outward motions while maintaining eye contact with the lens. (7) A 3D molecular model of the LIFR protein appears, consisting of numerous interlocking spheres in blue, white, and red. It rotates slowly against a blurred background of the host's torso. (8) The video returns to the host in the black shirt. He concludes his talk, smiles slightly, and points both index fingers downward toward the bottom of the frame where a call-to-action button would be. A blue and white logo is visible in the top left corner.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 中年肥肚兇手 幹細胞太勤勞!. [Subtitle]: 相信你也發現了. (2) [Subtitle]: 40 歲後的中年人肚子都開始變得大顆. (3) [Subtitle]: 所以我坐著. 不過這到底是為什麼呢. (4) [Subtitle]: 美國研究人員終於有了解答. (5) [Subtitle]: 而且不是熱狗跟可樂. (6) [Subtitle]: 世界知名的癌症研究治療以及預防機構. (7) [Subtitle]: City of Hope 發現隨著人到中年. (8) [Subtitle]: 我們體內脂肪組織會出現一群新型的脂肪幹細胞. (9) [Subtitle]: 叫做 CP-As. (10) [Subtitle]: 翻成中文呢就是信守承諾. (11) [Subtitle]: 而且年齡到了才會出現的脂肪前驅細胞. (12) [Variety]: CP-As 醬. [Subtitle]: 而且比起囤積在二頭肌 我更喜歡內臟. (13) [Subtitle]: 科學家從年長老鼠跟年輕老鼠身上. (14) [Subtitle]: 分別取得脂肪前驅細胞. (15) [Subtitle]: 移植給另一批年輕老鼠. (16) [Subtitle]: 來自年長鼠的脂肪前驅細胞就產生了大量的脂肪細胞. (17) [Subtitle]: 害得年輕鼠也長出一圈肥肉. (18) [Subtitle]: 欸要是反過來 把年輕鼠的細胞給年長鼠呢. (19) [Subtitle]: 就沒有明顯發胖哦. (20) [Subtitle]: 這證實了比較老的脂肪前驅細胞就是生產脂肪的原因呢. (21) [Subtitle]: 我靠 意思就是說別的幹細胞都是隨著年齡越來越大越來越弱. (22) [Subtitle]: 就只有脂肪幹細胞年紀越大越有活力. (23) [Subtitle]: 而且實驗還發現 在雄鼠身上特別如此. (24) [Subtitle]: 真是老不休. (25) [Subtitle]: 但這也就是說 如果開發出針對這個幹細胞的療法. (26) [Subtitle]: 或許能幫助我們對抗中年發福. (27) [Slogan]: 白血病抑制因子受體 (LIFR). [Subtitle]: 研究者的確發現. (28) [Subtitle]: 白血病抑制因子受體 (LIFR) 是關鍵. (29) [Subtitle]: CP-As 要生成脂肪 必須得有這個受體. (30) [Subtitle]: 抑制這個受體 並不影響年輕脂肪前驅細胞正常生成. (31) [Subtitle]: 而若在初老期 就進行長期的 LIFR 抑制劑治療. (32) [Subtitle]: 就能防止老鼠內臟脂肪擴張. (33) [Subtitle]: 哇真是太好了 看來我肚子變大. (34) [Subtitle]: 不是吃太多鐵板燒的問題 是脂肪幹細胞這個老不休的錯. (35) [Subtitle]: 話說水熊蟲的鐵板燒到底炒好了沒. (36) [Subtitle]: 想了解更多科學新聞嗎. (37) [Slogan]: 快點這裡. [Logo]: 快留言許願 下週《泛科學 NEWS》就來報!
